comments.text:
nine hub_* tools implemented on matchday/tk-sj9 (8b84a3f), pushed.

extensions/hub_tools.ts - all nine registered per docs/05 Tools:
- TypeBox schemas matching docs/05 sketches verbatim (wait_seconds 0-600 int, optional); descriptions registered word-for-word from docs/05.
- Routing per docs/05 dispatch rule, resolved at call time: hub-local when state.active and selfSessionId nonempty and local present (tk-hai closure seam, mirrored structurally - hub.ts entry guard and hub_local untouched) via local.core.surface.dispatch by plugin; peer relay otherwise via connectHubClient cmd frame, correlated reply, client closed after.
- Per-tool timeouts per docs/05 Routing lines: list 10s; send max(wait*1000+15s,30s); tool wait*1000+30s; spawn 60s; kill/archive/answer/assign 15s; attention 10s. Carried into the client deadline; timeout expiry is an isError envelope, never a rejection.
- Error rules: every failure path (validation, unreachable hub, op error, thrown body) resolves an isError tool result; catch-all in withSchema. hub_call_tool parses args JSON once; invalid JSON errors before any frame. tool op payload is docs/02 wire shape sessionId/tool/args.
- Result normalization: per-op renderers for list (roster+attention lines), spawn, kill, attention; others JSON. details carry op + raw reply/error.

Acceptance evidence:
- bun test workspace green: 597 pass / 0 fail, 10 consecutive full-suite runs after de-flaking 3 pre-existing Bun.sleep(5) roster waits in hub.test.ts (raced under load; replaced with status polling - no assertion changed).
- bunx tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.
- Tests per tool: schema validation (missing required fields, bounds -1/0.5/601 rejected vs 600 accepted, non-object args, invalid JSON in hub_call_tool, explode-proof catch-all); routing matrix (all nine hub-local ops list send tool spawn kill archive attention answer assign with by plugin and exact op args; relay same op+args; isHubLocal negative cases; timeouts asserted incl. formulas); e2e against a real temp hub.sock: relay (cmd frame to dispatch to reply to tool result, roster assertions) and hub-local through the real surface, dead-socket hub-unreachable envelope; registration (nine ToolDefinitions, execute guard, factory registers nine, brain guard still zero registrations).

Left OPEN for validator.
